title: Deep spec comprehension and synthesis
description: User requested deeply understanding the LICHEN specification. Read all current core chapters, relevant appendices and standalone drafts, adjudicated decisions, and canonical vector contracts; synthesize protocol invariants and complete lifecycles. Analysis only: no source/spec edits, no implementation audit, no commits or upstream writes.
design: Parallel layer-specific reading within the reading issue, followed by cross-layer reconciliation and a source-linked explanation. Use detailed normative chapters and spec/decisions.jsonl over stale overview prose; distinguish current baseline from optional and proposed profiles. Bare bd is used because beads-safe.sh automatically commits all Beads changes, which is outside this session authorization; its current header confirms bare writes are durable.
acceptance_criteria: All current spec areas covered; identity/routing/security/time/application interactions explained with source references; concrete unresolved contradictions separated from resolved choices; durable synthesis recorded in Beads.
